question: Evaluate the following statement regarding the operation of a cyclotron: 'The particle gains kinetic energy continuously throughout its entire circular path inside the Dees.'

options.A: True; the magnetic field does work continuously.
options.B: True; the electric field exists everywhere inside the Dees.
options.C: False; the magnetic field does no work, and the electric field is zero inside the hollow Dees.
options.D: False; energy is only gained when the particle hits the outer wall.
